metadata.dcterms:title: Three generations of colored fermions with S3 family symmetry from Cayley-Dickson sedenions
metadata.dcterms:creator: Gresnigta, Niels
metadata.dcterms:abstract: An algebraic representation of three genera- tions of fermions with SU(3)C color symmetry based on the Cayley–Dickson algebra of sedenions S is constructed. Recent constructions based on division algebras convinc- ingly describe a single generation of leptons and quarks with Standard Model gauge symmetries. Nonetheless, an alge- braic origin for the existence of exactly three generations has proven difﬁcult to substantiate. We motivate S as a nat- ural algebraic candidate to describe three generations with SU(3)C gauge symmetry. We initially represent one genera- tion of leptons and quarks in terms of two minimal left ideals of Cℓ(6), generated from a subset of all left actions of the complex sedenions on themselves. Subsequently we employ the S3 automorphism of order three, which is an automor- phism of S but not of O, to generate two additional genera- tions. Given the relative obscurity of sedenions, efforts have been made to present the material in a self-contained manner.
